'''Mara Tomanes''' is the name of a girlhood friend of [[Siuan Sanche]].

=="Activities"==
During her escape from [[Tar Valon]] after being deposed, Siuan told [[Gawyn]] that [[Elayne]] and [[Egwene]] were studying in [[Illian]] with an [[Aes Sedai]] of that name. This is the first example of Aes Sedai being able to lie when the [[Three Oaths]] are removed because of being [[stilled]].

She also uses the name as an alias when they are brought before [[Gareth Bryne]].
